events.content:
All routes and files have been migrated from the Pages Router to the App Router with TypeScript types, and the `pages/` directory has been removed:

- **Root Layout & Document**: Migrated `pages/_app.js` and `pages/_document.js` to `app/layout.tsx` using App Router `Metadata`, root `html`/`body` structure, and global styling.
- **Provider**: Migrated `components/AppProvider.js` to `components/AppProvider.tsx` with `'use client'` and TypeScript interfaces.
- **Home Route**: Migrated `pages/index.js` (`getServerSideProps`) to `app/page.tsx` as an `async` Server Component using `headers()` from `next/headers`, `metadata`, and client navigation component `ViewAllPostsButton` (`useRouter` from `next/navigation`).
- **Blog Routes**:
  - Migrated `pages/blog/index.js` (`getStaticProps` with ISR) to `app/blog/page.tsx` with `revalidate = 60` and `ReadMoreButton`.
  - Migrated `pages/blog/[id].js` (`getStaticPaths` + `getStaticProps`) to `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` with `generateStaticParams`, `generateMetadata`, `dynamicParams = true`, `notFound()` from `next/navigation`, and `app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx`.
- **Error Handling**: Migrated `pages/404.js` to `app/not-found.tsx` with `GoHomeButton` and `pages/_error.js` to `app/error.tsx` & `app/global-error.tsx`.
- **API Routes**: Migrated `pages/api/posts/index.js` and `pages/api/posts/[id].js` to App Router Route Handlers at `app/api/posts/route.ts` and `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` exporting typed HTTP method functions (`GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`).
